capability: Republish external runtime environment after Toolchain selection changes
searchEvidence: CodeGraph traced ToolchainAppliedAsync to RefreshRuntimeReadinessAfterPublicationAsync and found that it refreshed cached readiness without reloading the generation-bound ExternalProcessorEnvironmentLoader.
MessageCenterViewModel already owns every explicit external-environment load and diagnostics refresh; the correction reuses that owner instead of adding a second loader path.
AB Merge and CtrlRAM Replace are the current Presentation readiness caches backed by the external processor environment.
semanticOwner: MessageCenterViewModel external-environment lifecycle with existing Merge and Replace readiness projections
terminalContract: A successful Toolchain save first republishes the environment for the new configuration generation, then refreshes dependent readiness and global diagnostics; a failed publication stays visible and does not silently fall back

designReview.evidence: Bounded R1 correction of the existing post-save callback; no new public contract, runtime trust policy, firmware semantics, or alternate environment owner.

finalReview.evidence: Independent fixed-head review PASS at 18428abdad3ca5d78938215209185c810a5577e2 after two P2 findings were incorporated. Toolchain Save exclusively performs reload plus fresh diagnostics and readiness refresh; startup and explicit publication callbacks are refresh-only. Post-publication diagnostics waits any older active refresh before taking a new snapshot. AB Merge and CtrlRAM readiness follow the environment publication without recursion or silent fallback. Targeted UI evidence passed 24/24 with four startup/explicit cases asserting one environment generation; git diff --check passed. Native and release gates remain separate.
